name: flux-tail
description: The last N Flux records -- tail for records, terminator not counted.
notes:
The last N Flux records -- tail for records. Unlike plain tail it does not count the terminator as a record; it reads to the end, and ends with tail-stats:complete (count, records) when upstream said it finished.

Prototype for #62 (2026-10-13); promoted to Rust in #78 (2026-10-14), with the Python version kept as the diff-test reference. No short name yet: fhead is taken on npm (another use) and ftail on npm is a log tailer -- the same kind of tool, the #57 shape. Still undecided after the promotion.
